name: ○mouto Work! Ko○naka ni Ochin○n Hoshii no Onii-chan!
original_name: 〇もーとわーく！　こ〇なかにおちん〇ん欲しいのお兄ちゃん！
source:
My sister, who lost her job during the pandemic, moved into my place!?
Life with my laid-back little sister begins.
Wanting to earn some extra cash through remote work, my sister chose to become an adult streamer!?
Forbidden intimate contact with my sister!?
translation:
疫情期间失业的妹妹，搬进了我家！？
与悠闲随性的妹妹同居，开始了。
为了通过远程工作赚点外快，妹妹竟选择当成人主播！？
与妹妹之间，禁忌的亲密接触！？
